name: Extracurriculars
source:
It's Valentine's Day. You're alone and failing all your classes. You just can't seem to pick a struggle, can you? But, the universe finally heard your pleas and granted you personified incarnations of the subjects you're failing at: PE, Science, Math, and English. What could possibly go wrong?

Answer: Everything

Get your pick from Phy-Zeke-Cal Education, Ine-ertia, Al-Gebra, or Graham-er.

[From [url=https://lysterine.itch.io/extracurriculars]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
情人节到了。你形单影只，所有科目还都不及格。倒霉的事，你就不能只挑一件吗？不过，宇宙终于听见了你的哀求，把你不及格的四门课——体育、科学、数学与英语——变成了活生生的人，送到你面前。这还能出什么岔子呢？

答案：什么岔子都能出。

从体育化身Phy-Zeke-Cal Education、惯性化身Ine-ertia、代数化身Al-Gebra与语法化身Graham-er之中，挑选你的心仪对象吧。

[摘自[url=https://lysterine.itch.io/extracurriculars]itch.io[/url]]
